commit.message:
Include highlights in mixed feeds by default

The kind 9802 toggle (feedIncludeHighlights) was off by default,
so highlights only appeared on the dedicated /highlights page and
were invisible in the home Follows/Global/Communities tabs and on
profile pages. Default it to true so highlights show up alongside
posts, reposts, articles, and the other social kinds that already
default on. Users who don't want them can still turn the toggle
off in feed settings.

commit.message:
Polish NIP-84 highlight rendering

- Render highlight source URLs as rich link previews via LinkEmbed
  (matching how feed notes preview URLs), instead of the static URL
  chip that just showed hostname + raw URL.
- Drop the Highlighter icon from the top-right of the quote block.
  The left accent border and serif type already mark it as a pull
  quote, and the icon overlapped the text on long single-line
  highlights.
- Tighten 'context'-tag handling: only accept the tag when the
  highlight appears verbatim inside it, per the spec's stated intent
  ('surrounding content'). The previous heuristic ('context longer
  than content') admitted malformed tags where the context didn't
  actually wrap the highlight, leading to the awkward fallback that
  showed context above and the highlight as a separate quote. With
  the stricter check that fallback path is no longer reachable, so
  remove it.
- Swap the Highlighter (marker-pen) icon for the Quote (typographic
  quotation-marks) icon in every other place a highlight is
  represented: the comment-context icon map, the embedded-highlight
  card label, the notifications header icons (single + grouped),
  the feed-card KIND_HEADER_MAP, the Highlights sidebar item, and
  the highlights toggle in Notification Settings.
- Add a dedicated comment-context branch for kind 9802 so a reply
  to a highlight reads 'Commenting on @sebastix's highlight'
  (author attribution + hover-card preview via EmbeddedNote)
  instead of the generic 'Commenting on a highlight'. Mirrors the
  existing ReactionCommentContext / FollowListCommentContext
  pattern.
